jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Full Stack Engineer – Rotterdam – ALTEN

The Position

As part of our growing team, we are looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join us in Rotterdam and contribute to exciting, high-impact client projects across various industries.

As a Full Stack Engineer, your main tasks will include:

Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both frontend and backend systems
Building responsive and user-friendly interfaces using modern frontend technologies
Developing robust backend services, APIs, and integrations
Translating technical requirements into clean, efficient, and maintainable code
Identifying, analyzing, and resolving complex technical challenges with innovative solutions
Ensuring software quality through testing, code reviews, and engineering best practices
Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and high-performing solutions

Your Profile

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (HBO/WO) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
3–8 years of professional experience in full stack software development
Strong experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js
Experience with backend technologies such as Node.js, Java, Python, .NET, or similar
Knowledge of REST APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and modern software architectures
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to handle complex challenges
Excellent communication skills to engage with colleagues and clients at all levels
Positive mindset, proactive attitude, and eagerness to continuously learn and grow
Fluent in English (spoken and written)

Working Conditions

Lease car with fuel card
Possibility of hybrid working
Monthly net expense allowance
27 vacation days, with the option to purchase up to 10 extra vacation days
Pension scheme with no personal contribution required

What we offer

Access to exciting projects in key sectors:
Defence, Transport, Telecom, Finance
A diverse client base
: Collaborations with both large corporations and smaller players across the Netherlands
A real career development plan
: Continuous training, coaching, daily knowledge sharing
An innovative and collaborative environment

About ALTEN

ALTEN is a world leader in engineering and technology consulting, with over 57,700 employees in more than 30 countries. We support major companies in their innovation, R&D, and digital transformation projects across sectors such as automotive, aerospace, energy, finance, life sciences, and telecommunications.

Present in the Netherlands for over 20 years, ALTEN operates from its offices in Eindhoven, Capelle aan den IJssel, Apeldoorn, Groningen and Amstelveen. Today, with a team of 600+ consultants, ALTEN offers a wide range of expertise across Engineering and IT fields. From Automotive to Railway, and Defence to Aeronautics, our experts deploy their knowledge to provide innovative solutions in a dynamic and forward-thinking environment.

Ready for a new challenge?

Apply now and take part in innovative and impactful projects at ALTEN!

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The job

As a Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building and operating the software platform that powers Milence's heavy-duty transport charging network. You will develop cloud-native, event-driven systems that connect charging infrastructure, customers, operations and business processes. Reporting to the Head of Software Engineering, you will work closely with Product, Data and Engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable and reliable software solutions that support Milence's continued growth across Europe.

Reporting to the Head of Software Engineering, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation through deployment and operations. In addition, you will help drive engineering excellence through automation, DevOps practices, continuous improvement and collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.

What you will do

You will design, develop and enhance event-driven services, APIs and distributed applications using TypeScript, Node.js and modern cloud-native technologies, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure and maintainable.
You will contribute to customer-facing applications and internal platforms by developing React-based components and web applications that integrate seamlessly with back-end services and deliver a consistent user experience.
You will design and optimise databases, data models and data flows, ensuring applications meet security, reliability and performance requirements throughout the software lifecycle.
You will implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring and deployment solutions, leveraging cloud-native services, containerisation and serverless technologies to enable reliable and efficient software delivery.
You will troubleshoot complex technical issues, perform root cause analysis and implement structural improvements that strengthen platform resilience, availability and operational performance.
You will collaborate closely with Software Engineering, Data, Product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into effective technical solutions while continuously improving processes, tools and engineering practices.

What you bring

You hold a bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science or a related field and have at least three years of experience designing and developing cloud-native software applications in a professional environment.
You have strong hands-on experience with TypeScript and Node.js and are comfortable working with React or similar front-end frameworks.
You have experience building and operating cloud solutions on Azure, AWS or GCP and are familiar with event-driven architectures, microservices, APIs and distributed systems.
You understand database design, data modelling and security best practices and have experience optimising data performance and reliability. Experience with data platforms or data pipelines is considered an advantage.
You are familiar with DevOps tooling and practices, including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, monitoring and observability.
You are an analytical problem solver who enjoys working in collaborative environments and continuously seeks opportunities to improve products, processes and ways of working.
You communicate effectively in English and are motivated by Milence's mission to accelerate the transition towards sustainable transport.

What we offer

You'll be joining us at an exciting stage of growth where you can make a visible impact, work alongside passionate experts, and help solve some of the most complex challenges in the energy transition.
In return, we offer:
The opportunity to work on technology that contributes directly to a more sustainable future.
A high-impact role with significant ownership, autonomy and visibility across the business.
A collaborative, international and purpose-driven culture where innovation and continuous learning are encouraged.
The chance to work with leading industry partners, manufacturers and technology providers shaping the future of transport e-mobility.
Company annual incentive bonus plan.
Unlimited holiday policy.
Company pension plan.
A one-time home office allowance to create a comfortable and productive workspace.
Monthly phone allowance.
A 12-month fixed-term employment contract.

Ready to Charge the Future?

At Milence, we believe diverse perspectives drive better innovation and stronger outcomes. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, nationalities, identities and ways of thinking.
If you're excited about helping shape the future of charging technology and accelerating the transition to sustainable transport, we'd love to hear from you.
Come charge the future with us. Apply now and please submit your CV in English.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Associate

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Services for Renewable Energy, Truck Transportation, and Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
